# Template capability reference

Every capability a template can ask for, with its real, implemented status. A capability is a
reusable engine feature; enabling one grants nothing — the engine checks again when it acts.

**Status** is one of the four user states. *Available* means a registered setup handler delivers
it; a setup still sees *Needs configuration* (a sign-in or provider is needed) or *Unsupported
here* (this computer or this grid does not support it) depending on the computer and the grid
profile. *Planned* means it is described so you can find it, but no setup handler delivers it yet,
so it cannot be enabled. **Profiles** lists the grid profiles whose handler delivers it today;
empty means any setup the platform supports can use it. The live-research capability is
private-build only and never appears here.

## Grid & workers

| Capability | ID | What it does | Status | Profiles | Requirements | Permissions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Run on this computer only | `grid.local_only` | Keep the setup on this computer, with no grid and no other machines. | Available | — | Any computer | Run containers on this computer |
| Create a grid | `grid.create` | Start a grid this computer coordinates, so other machines can join it. | Available | Neo Grid, Sandbox Grid, Access Grid, Swarm Mining Grid | Any computer | Enroll computers into a grid |
| Join a grid | `grid.join` | Connect this computer to a grid someone else coordinates. | Available | Neo Grid, Sandbox Grid, Access Grid, Swarm Mining Grid | Any computer | — |
| Reuse idle computers | `grid.reuse_compute` | Let the grid place work on enrolled computers while they are idle. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Neo Grid | Any computer | Enroll computers into a grid |
| Choose which computers run work | `grid.selected_machines` | Place work only on the computers you pick, not the whole grid. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Neo Grid | Any computer | — |
| Rent cloud computers | `grid.cloud_compute` | Add rented cloud computers to the grid when local machines are not enough. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Neo Grid | Any computer | Rent cloud compute, which may cost money, Open a sign-in to a provider you choose |
| Limit what workers use | `grid.worker_limits` | Cap how many workers run and how much of each computer they may take. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Swarm Mining Grid | Any computer | — |
| Run only when computers are idle | `grid.availability` | Choose when a computer may take grid work, so it stays out of the way. | Available | Neo Grid, Sandbox Grid | Any computer | — |
| VM sandbox | `sandbox.vm` | Run work in a restricted virtual machine on this computer: a pinned minimal Linux guest with no network and none of your files unless you declare them. | Available | — | the VM sandbox | Run a restricted virtual machine on this computer, with no network and none of your files unless you declare them |
| Remote VM via SSH | `sandbox.remote` | Run a VM on an existing trusted SSH server, supervised by your local VM. Retries keep the original run and cleanup leaves the server's power and billing unchanged. | Available | — | the VM sandbox | Use an owned, explicitly trusted SSH connection to run a remote VM under a local parent's lease; the server operator and external billing remain your responsibility |

## AI tools & models

| Capability | ID | What it does | Status | Profiles | Requirements | Permissions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Built-in AI tools | `tools.builtin` | Add a tool from the supported built-in list, ready to run. | Available | — | containers | Run containers on this computer |
| Your own tool | `tools.custom` | Bring a tool of your own, from an image or project, instead of the built-in list. | Available | — | containers | Run containers on this computer |
| Provider access | `tools.provider_access` | Choose how a tool reaches a provider: an API key, a subscription sign-in, or both. | Available | — | Any computer | Open a sign-in to a provider you choose |
| Declared routes | `sandbox.routes` | Let the VM sandbox reach only the services you name, through Yougori's relay, with a credential the host adds and the sandbox never sees. | Available | — | the VM sandbox | Let the VM sandbox reach only the services you name, adding a credential you enrolled on the way out |
| Published guest service | `sandbox.publish` | Let the VM sandbox serve a page or an API of its own on this computer, reachable only when you publish it: to you with its address, or to anyone on this computer if you choose. | Available | — | the VM sandbox | Let the VM sandbox serve one of its own services on this computer, reachable only after you publish it |
| Connected VM sandbox | `sandbox.connect` | A second VM sandbox that serves one service the first reaches by name: nothing else of either is reachable from the other, and the grant expires. | Available | — | the VM sandbox | Let one VM sandbox of this setup reach one service of another, granted at both ends and only until the grant expires |
| Local models | `models.local` | Run a model on this computer or the grid, with no outside provider. | Available | — | a local model runner | Serve models from this computer |
| Cloud models | `models.cloud` | Use a model hosted by a provider, through a gateway in the setup that holds your key. | Available | — | containers | Open a sign-in to a provider you choose, Run containers on this computer |
| A model already set up | `models.existing` | Attach a model service this computer or grid already runs. | Available | Neo Grid | Any computer | — |
| A team of models | `models.team` | Run several models together so tools can route between them. | Available | Neo Grid | Any computer | — |
| Free models only | `models.free_only` | Allow only models with no usage charge, and stop if one starts costing money. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Review source in a sandbox | `research.source` | Run authorised research against imported source in its own isolated sandbox. | Available | Swarm Mining Grid | containers, a local model runner | Run authorised research in an isolated realm |

## Website & API

| Capability | ID | What it does | Status | Profiles | Requirements | Permissions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A website or API | `web.service` | Run a web service or API from the setup, on its own container port. | Available | — | containers | Run containers on this computer |
| Keep it to this computer | `web.private` | Reach the service only from this computer, with nothing exposed outside. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Reach it on the local network | `web.lan` | Let other computers on your network reach the service. | Available | — | Any computer | Open a port the computers of your local network can reach |
| A quick public link | `web.quick_link` | Open a temporary public web address through a tunnel. | Available | — | Any computer | Open a public web address for this setup |
| A custom domain | `web.domain` | Serve the setup on a domain you own, over HTTPS. | Available | — | Any computer | Open a public web address for this setup |
| Health check | `web.health` | Watch a health path so the setup knows when the service is really ready. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Charge for the application | `web.app_billing` | Give the application you run your payment provider's keys, so it can bill its own users. | Available | — | Any computer | Incur charges on a provider account you connect, Open a sign-in to a provider you choose |

## People & access

| Capability | ID | What it does | Status | Profiles | Requirements | Permissions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Just me, or a team | `people.team` | Keep the setup to yourself, or open it to named people. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Roles | `people.roles` | Give people owner, admin or member roles, with different powers. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Access Grid | Any computer | Invite people and set their roles |
| Workspaces | `people.workspaces` | Give people individual or shared workspaces built on your computers. | Available | Sandbox Grid | Any computer | — |
| Invites | `people.invites` | Invite people by a scoped invitation, entered privately. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Neo Grid (own), Access Grid, Swarm Mining Grid (own) | Any computer | Invite people and set their roles |
| Single sign-on | `people.sso` | Let people sign in through a supported identity provider. | Available | Sandbox Grid, Access Grid | Any computer | Open a sign-in to a provider you choose |
| Two-step sign-in | `people.mfa` | Require a second step when people sign in. | Available | Access Grid, Sandbox Grid | Any computer | — |
| Scoped credentials | `people.scoped_credentials` | Hand out narrow, short-lived access to a credential through a broker. | Available | Access Grid | Any computer | Hold credentials and hand out short-lived access |

| Storage drive | `data.storage_drive` | Choose which drive the setup keeps its data on. | Available | — | Any computer | Reserve storage on a drive you choose |
| Persistent volumes | `data.volumes` | Keep named data that survives stopping and restarting the setup. | Available | — | Any computer | Reserve storage on a drive you choose |
| Project source | `data.project_source` | Run the setup from a project folder you point to. | Available | — | Any computer | Read the project folder you select |
| Selected folders | `data.folders` | Grant the setup access to only the folders you choose. | Available | — | Any computer | Read only the folders you grant |
| Staged workspace | `sandbox.workspace` | Give the VM sandbox a copy of a folder you choose. Its changes reach your folder only when you review them and approve each file. | Available | — | the VM sandbox | Copy a folder you choose into the VM sandbox, and change that folder only with files you approve after a review |
| Sync | `data.sync` | Keep a folder in step with the setup, choosing direction and how conflicts resolve. | Available | — | Any computer | Read only the folders you grant |
| Databases | `data.databases` | Run a database for the setup and keep its data. | Available | — | containers | Run containers on this computer, Reserve storage on a drive you choose, Connect to a database you configure |
| Artifacts | `data.artifacts` | Keep the outputs a job or build produces, so you can read them later. | Available | — | Any computer | Reserve storage on a drive you choose |
| Private connections | `data.private_connections` | Connect the setup to a private service without opening it to the public. | Available | — | Any computer | — |

## Automation & recovery

| Capability | ID | What it does | Status | Profiles | Requirements | Permissions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Run as a service | `run.service` | Keep the setup running continuously, restarting it if it stops. | Available | — | containers | Run containers on this computer |
| Run as a job | `run.job` | Run the setup once to completion, rather than keeping it up. | Available | — | containers | Run containers on this computer |
| Distributed jobs | `run.grid_jobs` | Spread a job across the grid's computers, with leases and retries. | Available | Neo Grid, Sandbox Grid | Any computer | — |
| Schedule | `run.schedule` | Do something on a schedule you choose, in a time zone you name. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Run on an event | `run.events` | Run a job again when an event arrives: a call to its address, or a change in the folder it reads. | Available | — | Any computer | Open an address that runs one of its jobs again when it is called |
| Retries | `run.retries` | Try a job again a few times if it fails, with a bounded limit. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Quotas | `run.quotas` | Cap how much a setup may use, so it cannot run away. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Budget | `run.budget` | Set a spending limit, and stop before it is passed. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Backups | `run.backups` | Keep checksummed copies of a volume's data, and put one back when you need it. | Available | — | containers | Reserve storage on a drive you choose |
| Health and logs | `run.health_logs` | Watch health and read the setup's logs in one place. | Available | — | Any computer | — |
| Notifications | `run.notifications` | Be told when something important happens, such as a failure. | Available | — | Any computer | Send notifications you set up |
